title: TrueType font signature (0x00010000)
summary: A TrueType font file begins with the 4-byte scaler type 0x00010000 (often read as the version tag).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Followed by numTables (uint16), searchRange, entrySelector, rangeShift.
Contrast with OpenType (OTTO) and TrueType collections (ttcf).
